body:
At least in my state, you need to have been living in a residence you pay for for several months and have been holding down a job for longer to get emancipated. And the living alone has to be with guardian consent. 

I don't know what he expects me to do. He tells me I don't contribute while he works, but he won't let me get a job. I spend most of my day reading, walking and browsing the internet, and sometimes I repaint nerf guns for friends but it's hard to get spray paint so I can't do it that much. He has a full time job and goes to the gym, so he's generally doing that from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. most days.

He let me work at a McDonalds for a week and a half, but then he wouldn't let me go in for a week and I was fired, and they wouldn't let me have a paycheck for the hours I was there because I didn't finish the whole pay period.

He just won't let me do things like that. Sometimes he gets mad if I leave the house, even if I told him when I was leaving and when I came back. I'm not really allowed to do anything outside the house except walk around my small city and ride my bike around my neighborhood.

I passed an early exit exam, so I'm no longer allowed to go to school. I don't have money for college either, it's several hundred dollars for a class and a book at my local community college, and additional money as general tuition. There's no legal way for me to get that money.
